profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Financial Engineering at ingenium Inc.
profile.summary:
✔ Senior Software Engineer at ingenium Inc.
✔ Master's in Computer Science from Indiana University, Bloomington.
✔ Fluent in C++, C, Python, Bash scripting, Linux.
✔ Experienced Equities trader, technical analyst, stock portfolio adviser.
✔ Self-driven.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
► Implement FX feed handlers using fix8 libraries for ingenium's Liquidity Taking, Market Making
► Maintain and optimize ingenium’s latency-sensitive Trading Engine to provide Market Making 
solutions to Sell-side Customers using a web app
► Implemented Quote Conflation as a latency solution for Trading Engine’s order book
► Support Customer Relations – manual trade executions, drop copies, Server SW updates, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Trading Engine · Software Design · Software Infrastructure · Market Making · Cryptocurrency Trading · Bash

positions.description:

► Maintain oneAPI Collective Communications Library (oneCCL) tests in CI/CD
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python · Linux · Software Design · Software Infrastructure · Cloud Computing
